about:
HTS Fabrication, Inc. was founded in 1993 in Lakeville, Minnesota, where it operates from a facility on Hamburg Avenue. The company began as a solutions provider focused on custom metal fabrication and machine building, staffed by a design team, certified welders, and machine builders.

The shop offers engineering and machine design, custom metal fabrication in aluminum and carbon steel, machine assembly, material handling system fabrication, and enamel and epoxy painting. Work is performed from customer prints or from concept, covering projects from simple brackets to complex capital equipment. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers span industrial manufacturing, food processing, outdoor equipment, and cabinet and enclosure production. Named accounts include 3M, B&G Foods, Toro, and Crenlo, all of which have used HTS to build efficient, ergonomic manufacturing facilities and improve production flow.

The company says its differentiator is the ability to create one-of-a-kind products not found in catalogs, backed by fast turnaround times and direct, one-on-one collaboration. Its stated specialty is custom manufacturing and material handling products that improve production flow and employee safety.
